liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playin' In The Band** (3 reviews): Reviewer especially likes the Playin' here, typical of how the band stretched out jams in this era; A solid, big Playin' anchors the end of the first set [8][10][13]
- **You Ain't Woman Enough** (1 review): Rare number showcasing Donna's voice while Garcia twangs along behind her [10]
- **Here Comes Sunshine** (1 review): Here Comes Sunshine moves along at a nice upbeat tempo [14]
- **The Other One** (1 review): The Other One is called outstanding on the audience recording [12]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-06-26.sbd.GoodBear.80602.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 31 songs; 203 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Soundboard matrix has minimal audience patches at the start; board resumes at Jack Straw, smooth sounding; Board source is missing for Black Peter, as well as the end of Sugar Magnolia and the encore; Audience patch fills Loser from about 2:55 to 3:22, plus Casey Jones through Brown Eyed Women and the end of Sugar Magnolia [1][14]
- **gd1973-06-26.mtx.seamons.100024.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 32 songs; 211 min; rated 3.78/5 by 9 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience patches used in Truckin' from about 4:18 to 4:42, and in Loser [2]
- **gd73-06-26.sbd.cotsman.12076.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 31 songs; 206 min; rated 3.5/5 by 8 [3]. Said about its sound: Matrix mix jumps back and forth between audience and board sources, which the reviewer finds annoying [9]
- **gd73-06-26.aud.weiner.gdADT14.14673.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 31 songs; 205 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [4]. Said about its sound: Audience tape has splices from another source in a couple songs; rough, with uneven levels [8]
- **gd1973-06-26.aud.jems.105840.flac16**: audience recording; 32 songs; 237 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [6]. Said about its sound: JEMS master audience recording described as very good to excellent, with all songs complete [6]

## Around the show

- Show was at the Seattle Center Arena, not the Coliseum; earlier transfer carried wrong venue info [18]
- Reviewer groups this show with the PNE and Portland shows from the same week as especially inspired Northwest music [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-06-26.sbd.GoodBear.80602.flac16**: transferred by Teddy Goodbear; source: Teddy edited all original aud shnid "12076" with silence removal, heavy hiss reduction, eq'ing and retracking in late 11/2006. [1]
- **gd1973-06-26.mtx.seamons.100024.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [2]. Also: Donn Amick recorded front-of-board row with Sony EMC mics onto cassette; Noah Weiner transferred reels to digital in November 2002 [2]
- **gd73-06-26.sbd.cotsman.12076.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard with audience patches [3]. Also: Soundboard source patched with audience tape, slight pitch correction applied; seeded to etree by Mark [3]
- **gd73-06-26.aud.weiner.gdADT14.14673.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Donn Amick; transferred by Noah Weiner; source: Audience Recording: FOB, Sony EMC mics spread out across the row > TC-152 master cassette > Amick's Reel recorded at 7-1/2ips > Reel(w/ Dolby) [4]. Also: Audience tape was made by the same taper as the 6/22/73 show, though slightly less glorious [12]
- **gd1973-06-26.aud.jems.105840.flac16**: taped by Jems; transferred by Jems; source: Sony ECM22p > Tandberg 11 > Master Reels [6]
